policy: No Tutela requirement or decision makes requirement-to-test traceability a release gate, so the count is a ratchet: `tutela trace` fails CI only if the number of requirements with no test reference rises above maxUntested. Lower maxUntested whenever the count drops; never raise it without a dated rationale here.
counting: A requirement is traced only when a file under tests/ names its id (TUT-nnnn). A reference in src/ is reported as code-only and is not counted as coverage. A reference is a claim to be reviewed, not proof of complete verification.
